summary: Learn to test property funding assumptions, track lender conditions and prepare closing-ready finance reports. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Real estate transaction financing involves preparing and coordinating funding for property acquisitions, refinancing and development. For finance analysts, transaction managers and credit professionals, the work is to show that valuation, cash requirements and repayment assumptions support a fundable deal. You’ll reconcile sources and uses, test loan-to-value, debt-service coverage and debt-yield measures, and track lender conditions, drawdown readiness and closing actions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, review or coordinate funding for property acquisitions, refinancing and development transactions. It is designed for roles that must connect valuation evidence, lender requirements, cash-flow assumptions and closing actions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of real estate transactions and basic financial statements is expected. Familiarity with property cash flows is useful; no coding or programming is required.
